name: AIGVE-Tool Benchmark
description: A multifaceted evaluation toolkit and benchmark for assessing the quality of AI-generated video along multiple axes (e.g., fidelity, temporal coherence, perceptual quality).
evaluation_method: human_eval (MOS) supplemented by objective video metrics (e.g., FVD, LPIPS, SSIM)
general_score_metric: Mean Opinion Score (MOS) and FVD/LPIPS as primary quantitative complements
reputation: A focused toolkit/benchmark for AI‑generated video quality assessment with niche but growing interest among video‑generation researchers.
notes: Relies on subjective human judgments (MOS) which can be variable; objective metrics (FVD/LPIPS/SSIM) have known sensitivities and may not fully correlate with perceived quality; dataset size and diversity may be limited; non-LLM benchmark.
